== Description ==

[[Joe Phillips]] (left, black Columbia fleece over Star Wars tee), [[Jack Douglass]] (center, blue beaver-logo tee, glasses, beard, hair bun), [[Ken Cross]] (front left (back), short grey-blond hair, black tee), and [[Mark Billings]] (right (back), ponytail, glasses, navy/gold chevron top) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
